#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed VEIN server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/vein/gamedash-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/vein/gamedash-servers/test/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/Game.ini" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import re, sys
p, join, admin = sys.argv[1:4]
t = open(p, encoding="utf-8", newline="").read()     # keep its line endings
bom = "\ufeff" if t.startswith("\ufeff") else ""
t = t[len(bom):]
for key, val in (
    ('Password', join),
):
    line = key + '=' + val
    pattern = r'(?m)^' + re.escape(key + '=') + r'[^\r\n]*'
    if re.search(pattern, t):
        t = re.sub(pattern, lambda m: line, t)
    else:
        head = '[/Script/Vein.VeinGameSession]'
        t = (t.replace(head, head + '\n' + line, 1) if head in t
             else t + '\n' + head + '\n' + line + '\n')
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write(bom + t)
SYNC
for lib in "$HOME/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so" "$HOME/.local/share/Steam/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so" "$HOME/.steam/steam/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so" "<ROOT>/installs/vein/linux64/steamclient.so"; do
    [ -e "<ROOT>/installs/vein/Vein/Binaries/Linux/steamclient.so" ] && break
    [ -e "$lib" ] && ln -s "$lib" "<ROOT>/installs/vein/Vein/Binaries/Linux/steamclient.so"
done
cd "<ROOT>/installs/vein/" || exit 1
exec ./Vein/Binaries/Linux/VeinServer-Linux-Test Vein -log -userdir="<ROOT>/installs/vein/gamedash-servers/test" -Port=7790 -QueryPort=27200
